Il carcinoma squamoso è fortemente legat:
Squamous cell carcinoma is strongly linked to smoking; it is recognised by keratinisation and intercellular bridges. In poorly differentiated cases immunohistochemistry is needed (p40 and p63 positive, TTF-1 negative; adenocarcinoma is usually TTF-1 positive).
Radiological correlation: more often central, near the main or lobar bronchi (atelectasis, obstructive pneumonia), but also peripheral as in this case; it tends to cavitate (keratin necrosis). It can cause paraneoplastic hypercalcaemia (PTHrP). The CT T stage depends on the largest diameter of the solid component: T1b > 1 and ≤ 2 cm (TNM 8th edition).
Polmone: cheratina e ponti intercellular: Lung: keratin and intercellular bridges = squamous; glands or lepidic growth = adenocarcinoma.
